source_caption:
🎬 The Cobbler (2014)

The Cobbler follows Max Simkin, a lonely shoe repairman living in New York City who spends his days working in the small shop his family has owned for generations. Tired of his repetitive routine and dreaming of a different life, Max unexpectedly discovers that an old stitching machine possesses a magical ability: whenever he repairs someone’s shoes and puts them on, he can physically transform into that person. Fascinated by his newfound power, Max begins experiencing life through the identities of his customers, leading to hilarious misunderstandings, unexpected adventures, and dangerous situations. However, as he becomes involved in other people’s complicated lives, he discovers that his extraordinary gift comes with serious responsibilities. Starring Adam Sandler, Dustin Hoffman, and Steve Buscemi, the film combines fantasy, comedy, and heartfelt moments while exploring identity, family, compassion, and the importance of appreciating your own life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Fantasy

⭐ IMDb: 5.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 39m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Tom McCarthy

✍️ Writers: Tom McCarthy & Paul Sado

source_details.title: The Cobbler
source_details.synopsis: The Cobbler is a 2014 American magic realism comedy-drama film directed by Tom McCarthy and cowritten by McCarthy with Paul Sado. The film stars Adam Sandler as a cobbler who finds himself able to assume the form of anyone by putting on their shoes. The supporting cast includes Cliff "Method Man" Smith, Ellen Barkin, Melonie Diaz, Dan Stevens, Fritz Weaver, Yul Vazquez, Steve Buscemi, and Dustin Hoffman. The Cobbler premiered at the 2014 Toronto International Film Festival, where it was screened in the Special Presentations section. The film was released in U.S. theaters on March 13, 2015, by Image Entertainment. The Cobbler was panned by critics, and was a box-office bomb, grossing $6.5 mil
